parameters.formTitle: Report a Bug from a Screenshot
parameters.formDescription: Upload the screenshot and the rest is drafted for you. The two optional boxes are the only things the image cannot show, so anything you leave blank is marked Not Provided rather than guessed.

values.placeholder: The steps you actually took. A screenshot cannot show this, so anything you leave out here will be marked Not Provided rather than guessed.
Paste any console, network or server output. Optional.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, temperature: $json.temperature, reasoning_effort: $json.reasoning_effort, max_completion_tokens: $json.max_completion_tokens, messages: $json.messages }) }}
